title: Add / Validate Translations for MAP v1 Services
body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
Add required translations for our v1 services:

- pidgin 
- Igbo 
- Yoruba 

- Thai
- Punjabi 
- Afaan Oromoo
- Amharic
- Tigrinya
- Korean 
- Marathi
- Telugu
- Gujarati


**Describe the solution you'd like**
We need to ensure we have the correct translations for these services : 

- Cookie Banner 
- Privacy Banner 
- Footer 
- Timestamps 
- Related Content Header 

Please refer to the translations spreadsheet - pinned in the media pod channel 

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
N/A

**Testing notes**
[Tester to complete]

Dev insight: Should we add cypress tests to all services for this?

- [ ] This feature is expected to need manual testing.

**Additional context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body:
Pidgin link 'Why you fit trust BBC News' shoud go to https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/institutional-48528766 (in Pidgin language), but actually goes to https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/help-41670342 (in English Language).

This is also happening with Igbo and Yoruba.

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body:
If the URL is bbc.com/pidgin/
Then if I add /media-511121201 to the end, which is a non-existent page (just changed the last number), should that have the Pidgin 404 error translations? Currently when I do that, it is in english as below:

![Image 17-01-2020 at 11 28](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/54575620/72609501-fd507f00-391c-11ea-8662-3c6b0d21cb62.jpg)

This is also happening with igbo.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
This seems to be an issue with the routing refactor - not with the translations.

Translations are there, but the request isn't reaching Simorgh - it's just hitting a Mozart error page that is using Simorgh's design

Conversation in Mozart's slack: https://bbcnews.slack.com/archives/C2BU2N4TH/p1579279652055500
